HIGH PRECISION WEIGHING CONTROLLER 24-Bit ADC (16M Counts)

Process Indicator ASDF-2601

Microcontroller-based indicator engineered for accurate and reliable load cell signal processing. Features a vibrant 6-digit red 7-segment LED display and tactile membrane keypad. Converts analog load cell signals into precise engineering values with a user-friendly interface for configuration, calibration and parameter adjustment.

Technical Specifications

Display 6 Digits, 7 segments RED LED (0.56")
Keyboard 4 Keys Membrane (IND/ENT, ►, ▲, ESC)
ADC Resolution 24-bit Delta-Sigma (16 Million counts)
Analog Output 4-20 mA, 0-20 mA, 0-10 V, 0-5 V
Linearity Within 0.01% F.S.
Load Cell Tech & Excitation 4-wire; 5 V DC at 200 Ω, max. 100 mA
Communication & Baud Isolated RS-485 / RS-232C, Modbus RTU (1200-115200)
Digital I/O 2 Inputs, 2 Relays, 2 Transistors
Power & Dimensions 10...28 V DC (250 mA); 48 x 96 x 75 mm Panel Mount

Typical Applications

Platform Scales Conveyor Weighing Tank & Hopper Weighing Process Control Batching Systems Packaging Machines Check Weighing Custom Automation
